verified_fact: Mahishasura had a boon that no man or male god could kill him. All the gods combined their powers to create Durga — each gave her a weapon. Durga battled Mahishasura for 9 days/nights, finally killing him on the 10th day (Vijayadashami). The 9 nights are celebrated as Navratri.
voiceover_script: Mahishasura ko vardaan mila — koi purush ya deva maar nahi sakta! Usne teen lok par kabza kiya. Devata haare — Brahma, Vishnu, Shiv — sab ne apni shakti ek jagah di. Us shakti se janm hui Maa Durga! Har devata ne ek hatyar diya. 9 din, 9 raat Durga aur Mahishasura ki bhayankara yudh. Daswen din — mahishasura ka ant! Ye 9 raat aaj manate hain Navratri naam se!

Mahishasura had a boon that no man or male god could kill him. All the gods combined their powers to create Durga — each gave her a weapon. Durga battled Mahishasura for 9 days/nights, finally killing him on the 10th day (Vijayadashami). The 9 nights are celebrated as Navratri.
